capabilities: View PPTX files slide by slide with thumbnails, full screen, and remembered reading position
Read DOCX files in a continuous read-only view
Search within the currently open presentation or document
Copy stable slide references, embeds, and selected text with source
Create a companion Markdown note for an open presentation
extras: Strictly read-only and desktop-only: no editing, saving, conversion, cloud rendering, or vault-wide indexing; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian cannot open Office file formats natively, so reading a presentation or Word document means leaving the app for PowerPoint or Word.
summary: Read-only viewer that opens local PPTX and DOCX files inside Obsidian with slide navigation, in-document search, and stable slide references and embeds.
